findings.finding: M2/M3 historical reports record dirty revisions, differing timing/control and binary conditions; current pinned documentation is not an exact executable reproduction or calibration of authored F/U likelihoods.

The trial-A reread is one event; new wrapper identity or equal/different summary hashes alone establishes neither fresh conditional independence nor duplicate trial identity. Different genuine trials may share summary bytes.

Losses, pilot and migration costs are invented comparable teaching points. Horizon reuse assumes stable latent state, losses, likelihoods and controls; no host/agent calibration or engineering-time conversion inferred.
Pinned agentic guide recommendations and historical model claims are opinions/project methodology, not current reliability measurements.
